device.description: dual 8-bit voltage-output DAC with 3-wire SPI/TMS320 serial interface, double-buffered DAC B, programmable settling time and power down

registers.name: LATCHA
registers.note: DAC A latch (no double buffer: also its input register); power-on reset clears the latches to all zero

registers.name: BUFFER
registers.note: BUFFER latch, the input register of DAC B; power-on zero

registers.name: LATCHB
registers.note: DAC B latch; loaded from the serial word (R1 R0 = 00) or from BUFFER (R1 R0 = 10)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: SPD (D14, 1 = fast) and PWR (D13, 1 = power down) of the last word; reset to 0 at power up

commands.name: Write DAC A, update DAC B from BUFFER (R1 R0 = 10)
commands.note: D15 R1, D14 SPD, D13 PWR, D12 R0, data MSB first; DAC A latch written, DAC B updated with the BUFFER content

commands.name: Write DAC B and BUFFER (R1 R0 = 00)
commands.note: the data goes to BUFFER and DAC B

commands.name: Write BUFFER (R1 R0 = 01)
commands.note: BUFFER only; DAC A and B unchanged

commands.name: Reserved (R1 R0 = 11)
commands.note: reserved register select; the power-down example (X X 1 X ...) shows SPD/PWR taking effect whatever R1 R0 are, so the program bits are stored

protocol.note: CS falling starts the frame; DIN sampled MSB first on SCLK falling edges (SCLK high at CS falling, Figure 1 -> mode 2); after 16 bits the shift register moves to the latches the R1/R0 bits select

device.note: tlv5625.pdf (SLAS233D) p.1 (D pinout, description), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V), p.6 (digital input timing, Figure 1), p.10 (power-on reset to zero, serial interface), p.11 (data format: R1 SPD PWR R0 + 8 data bits + 0000, register-select bits), p.12 (power-down example)

pages: (SLAS233D) p.1 (D pinout, description), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V), p.6 (digital input timing, Figure 1), p.10 (power-on reset to zero, serial interface), p.11 (data format: R1 SPD PWR R0 + 8 data bits + 0000, register-select bits), p.12 (power-down example)
notModeled: analog: voltage outputs (x2 buffer), reference REF input; SPD (settling) and PWR (power down) affect the analog side only (stored in CTRL)
a frame cut short by CS rising before 16 bits (the datasheet moves the partial shift register to the latches) is discarded
the extra SCLK rising edge after D0 that resets the internal state machine (p.10) is not needed by the model
DAC A has no double buffer: its input and DAC register are the same latch (dac lists LATCHA twice)
variants: tlv5625.pdf covers only the TLV5625 (C and I grades); TLV5617A (10-bit) and TLV5618A (12-bit) share the interface.
